sections.title: Questions and complete short answers
body: Hur asks about manner or condition: Hur mår du?
Answer Ja/Nej plus a detail, not only one word.
Ask Kan du upprepa frågan? when needed.

sections.title: Question word or verb first
body: Information questions use question word + finite verb + subject: Var bor du?
Yes/no questions begin with the finite verb: Bor du här?
Varför asks for a reason; answer with för att + clause.

assignment.title: Episode 8 mission: Questions and complete short answers
assignment.instructions:
LISTEN: Hear the audio twice and answer: Where is the course?

READ: Read once for purpose and once for detail. Answer: Why does the person study Swedish?

SPEAK: Ask four questions about place, time, activity, and reason. Try once without the model, then repeat more clearly.

WRITE: Write a three-question mini interview. Check word order and spelling.

TRANSFER: Turn one answer into a yes/no follow-up.

RETURN: Build one var-question and one yes/no question.
assignment.model:
Speaking: Var bor du? När arbetar du? Vad gör du på kvällen? Varför studerar du svenska?
Writing: Var bor du? Jag bor i Vasa.
Arbetar du hemma? Ja.
När börjar du? Klockan åtta.

takeaways: Use: Var arbetar du och när börjar du?
Rule: Information questions use question word + finite verb + subject: Var bor du?
